rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Mac Shell MCP Server enables secure execution of macOS terminal commands through ZSH shell with a built-in security system that categorizes commands as safe, requiring approval, or forbidden. It features a pre-configured whitelist of common commands, an approval workflow for potentially dangerous operations, and comprehensive command management tools. Written in TypeScript and designed to work with Roo Code and Claude Desktop, it can be installed locally or run via npx, making it ideal for AI assistants that need controlled access to the macOS terminal while maintaining security through command whitelisting and explicit approval mechanisms.
